title: Narvi — Sandbox Lifecycle
description: Spawn/boot latency and watchdog health for the sandbox lifecycle: how long it takes a sandbox to become usable, and how reliably the liveness watchdogs detect a genuinely dead one without false-alarming on a slow-but-alive one. Panels correspond to §5.3's own metric list (docs/TECHNICAL_PLAN.md) plus IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md row 77's named 'orphans' and 'boot p95' subjects. Every metric name below is checked against the real registered OTel instruments by internal/ops's own drift test (go test ./internal/ops/...) — a panel referencing a renamed or removed metric fails that build.

panels.title: Sandbox spawn latency (p95)
panels.description: p95 of sandbox_spawn_duration_seconds — wall-clock duration of one real SandboxProvider.CreateSandbox/RestoreFromSnapshot/ResumeSandbox call (internal/app/sessionactor/dispatch.go's executeSpawn/executeRestore/executeResume). §5.3's own 'spawn latency'. Tagged by action (spawn/restore/resume) and outcome (success/failure) — break out by action to tell a slow provider apart from a slow restore path.

panels.title: Sandbox boot-to-ready duration (p95)
panels.description: p95 of sandbox_agent_boot_duration_seconds — total wall-clock duration of one boot-to-ready sequence (repo clone/sync through RunBoot's own hook/service startup), still MEASURED sandbox-agent-side but RECORDED control-plane-side from a relayed best-effort boot_timing event (§33.3, internal/app/sessionactor/boottiming.go). IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md row 77's own 'boot p95' subject. Tagged by boot_mode and failed.

panels.title: Boot hook (setup.sh/start.sh) duration (p95)
panels.description: p95 of sandbox_agent_hook_rerun_duration_seconds — one hook's own wall-clock duration, including a workspaceMoved-triggered non-fatal setup.sh rerun under repo_image (§19.4/§19.5). §5.3's own 'boot phase durations'. Tagged by hook/failed/boot_mode/workspace_moved -- NOT repo (§33.3: dropped as unbounded metric-attribute cardinality; still visible per-session in the raw event log).

panels.title: Boot-time git fetch duration (p95)
panels.description: p95 of sandbox_agent_git_fetch_duration_seconds — the §19.3 boot-time fetch step, one repo. §5.3's own 'boot phase durations'. Tagged by degraded -- NOT repo (§33.3: dropped as unbounded metric-attribute cardinality; still visible per-session in the raw event log).

panels.title: Boot-time git checkout duration (p95)
panels.description: p95 of sandbox_agent_git_checkout_duration_seconds — SyncAll's own checkoutBranch step, one repo. §5.3's own 'boot phase durations'. Tagged by failed -- NOT repo (§33.3: dropped as unbounded metric-attribute cardinality; still visible per-session in the raw event log).

panels.title: Liveness gap at watchdog activation (p95)
panels.description: p95 of sandbox_liveness_gap_seconds — how long a sandbox had shown no sign of life by the moment a watchdog (inactivity/connecting_deadline/liveness_check) actually suspected it. §5.3's own 'liveness gaps'. Bounded below by whichever budget the firing watchdog uses (FirstConnectBudget/SteadyHeartbeatBudget/InactivityTimeout) by construction — watch for this creeping materially ABOVE that budget, which points at the timer pump itself falling behind, not genuine sandbox silence.

panels.title: Watchdog activations (rate)
panels.description: Rate of watchdog_activation_total — every sandbox a liveness/inactivity watchdog suspected (transitioned to Suspect). §5.3's own 'watchdog activations'. Tagged by watchdog (inactivity/connecting_deadline/liveness_check); excludes the distinct permanent-provider-error spawn-failure path, which is not a watchdog silence.

panels.title: Watchdog false-alarm rate
panels.description: watchdog_false_alarm_total / watchdog_activation_total — the fraction of watchdog activations that turned out to be wrong (the sandbox recovered during its own terminal_grace window, proving it was alive the whole time). §5.3's own '...and how many were false alarms — target: ~0'.

panels.title: Orphan sandboxes reaped (rate)
panels.description: Rate of orphans_reaped — provider-side sandbox instances found with no live Postgres owner and stopped by the reconciler (internal/app/reconciler). IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md row 77's own 'orphans' subject; §5.3's own 'orphan GC count'.
